page.overview:
Who is Inferno Henchman?

The Inferno Henchman, or simply Henchman, is an Agents minifigure introduced in 2008.

The Inferno Henchman wears a black tuque and a bright orange zipsuit featuring the Inferno emblem on his torso. His hip and gloves are dark stone grey. He carries the same guns as the Agents and Dr. Inferno's other henchmen. He uses a common Crook face with stubble and a wide grin showing a gold tooth. Unlike most other Agents villains, this Henchman appears entirely human and is not a cyborg or mutant.

Inferno Henchmen are the foot soldiers of Dr. Inferno's army, assisting Gold Tooth and Spy Clops in their evil schemes.
